purpose: Teach: 電信/依拠/手がける/内地/買い換え/受取/田舎町/廃業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、電信で全国の取引先と連絡されたぞ
lines.en: Your father used telegraph to communicate with business partners across the country when he founded the company.
lines.style: Warm, measured delivery. Slight nostalgic weight on the memory. Gentle pace, like sharing something precious. Eyes distant with time. Pause before the final detail, letting it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営判断を実データに依拠された
lines.en: Yes. He based his management decisions on real data.
lines.style: Steady, respectful affirmation. Light emphasis on 「実データ」 — acknowledging his father's rigor. Calm, almost contemplative. Not defensive, but thoughtful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、難しい新事業を自ら手がける方だったぞ
lines.en: Your father wasn't afraid to take on difficult new ventures himself.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Slight warmth underneath — admiration, not performance. Unhurried delivery. Trailing slightly at the end, lost in the memory for a moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは内地の各支店を巡回された
lines.en: Yes. He personally visited each branch office throughout the country.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Firm respect for the effort implied. Measured pace. No embellishment — just stating what he did, weight in the simplicity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の机を計画的に買い換えで更新されたぞ
lines.en: Your father deliberately upgraded the staff's desks over time — a small detail that mattered.
lines.style: Slower, more tender. Slight smile in the voice — noticing the care in what seemed small. Emphasis on the intentionality, not the gesture itself. Trailing off with quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお取引先の受取書類を丁寧に管理された
lines.en: Yes. He handled the end of business partnerships with remarkable sincerity and care.
lines.style: Calm, steady respect. Emphasis on 「誠実に」 — the integrity was the point. Measured, almost solemn. Not dramatic, but the weight of character in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、田舎町に支店を出される決断もされたぞ
lines.en: Your father made the bold choice to open a branch in a small rural town.
lines.style: Admiration with restraint. Slight emphasis on the courage of the decision. Reflective pace. Not theatrical — just recognizing something that took both vision and risk.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは取引先の廃業時にも誠実にご対応された
lines.en: Yes. Even when business partners had to close, he treated them with unwavering integrity.
lines.style: Quiet, solemn close. Full weight on 「誠実に」 — this is his father's character distilled. Slower delivery, almost reverent. Closing with composed finality — not sad, but dignified.
